root_cause: Hourly Powerhouse blog publisher failed at localized-routes because the translation pipeline attempted Anthropic first with credit balance too low; a separate approved blog supply workflow used Claude Code action requiring an unavailable OIDC token. Both stopped before valid protected blog publication.
intervention: Replace native blog generation's Anthropic action with a bounded OpenAI Responses API call and strict JSON schema; route scoped bilingual prepublish translations exclusively through the existing OpenAI API translation transport, keeping the cache complete before protected merge. Migrate the separately scheduled Weekblog and blog-bijwerken agent actions to the official OpenAI Codex GitHub Action (trusted bot, drop-sudo, restricted workspace) without changing their deterministic candidate-PR validation.
prevention: No Anthropic dependency in these two canonical active execution paths, no fallback to unapproved text, no publication from a generation artifact without Notion validation, full English cache, Required CI, protected merge, Netlify production provider and public URL evidence.
